subject: Spec review done: verdict FAIL, 8 blocking
body: Verdict FAIL: I ran /sc:spec-panel-armb in critique mode (requirements and architecture) on orca-worker-contract-spec.md, re-checked its load-bearing citations against the files, and wrote the full panel result with a numbered findings list to review/spec-panel.md without editing the spec. The core decision (Orca coordinates, commands stay the units of work) holds, but there are 8 blocking findings: WC-4 status values clash with the existing success value (F1); contract paths are undefined for file-output and workflow commands (F2); the Phase 0 and Phase 1 checks cannot pass as written (F3, F4); a retry overwrites the first attempt (F5); WC-10 conflicts with Agent-tool fan-out (F6); cli-portify gates have no answer flag (F7); and WC-7 never says the skill must be loaded (F8). Left for Task 6: revise the spec for F1-F8 per the Reviser brief in the report; 8 minor notes are optional, and no live Orca run or test run was made.
